environment: Mac ARM64; CPU Kokoro 0.9.4, FFmpeg 9.0.1, official Audacity 4.0.2 Linux ARM64 on a task-local virtual display; headless Chromium and Firefox.

details.listenFor: Follow twelve, eleven and ten watts to thirty-three, then a thirty-watt budget to a three-watt shortfall. Listen especially for the final s in “three watts” around 5.2–5.9 seconds.
details.findings: The full new spoken line awaits ordinary-speaker and headphone listening.
